subject: URGENT: Exec clearance needed — territory carve-out + market-favor clause
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Exec clearance needed — territory carve-out + market-favor clause

Team,

Quick background: Novara AI (large Series C health analytics prospect) is at the final commercial stage. They want two non-standard asks: a territory carve-out (their existing customers in APAC & LATAM only) plus a market-favor clause that would require us to match any materially better commercial terms we give to competitors in the same sector for 12 months.

Commercials:
- ARR: $2.4M first-year (annualized)
- Proposed discount: 30% on list for first 12 months, step-down thereafter
- Term: 24 months

Why this is risky:
- MFN / market-favor creates open-ended exposure if we change pricing or run pilot programs with other customers in the health vertical.
- Territory carve-out may create precedence for region-based carveouts; hard to track and enforce.

What I'm proposing as a compromise to close:
1) Limited MFN carve-in that only applies to direct, enterprise-level agreements with equivalent seat counts (>=500 seats) and only to list price (no promotional credits). Cap exposure to a single benchmark review during month 12.
2) Territory carve-out scoped to a named customer list and explicitly timeboxed to existing accounts as of signing; require Novara to provide verified customer list and agree to quarterly reporting.
3) Include a clause requiring a 30-day notice and right to cure before any MFN adjustment.

Attachments: Novara_SOW_redline.pdf (redlines + proposed language).

Ask: I need exec signoff to accept the scoped carve-out + limited MFN structure and to approve the 30% discount and 24-month term. If we cannot get signoff, I need guidance on the absolute no-go points to push back on.

Proposed sign-off approvers: Rishi (pricing), Laura (legal), Jordan (rev ops / governance).

Thanks,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer

Subject: Re: URGENT: Exec clearance needed — territory carve-out + market-favor clause

Karthik — thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I vote:
- Is the 30% discount conditioned on volume or committed usage? If they ramp slowly, do we have guarantees?
- Can we isolate risk operationally (i.e., route Novara traffic to a dedicated pool) so any performance-related concessions don't cascade?

If this is truly $2.4M ARR committed with an execution guarantee (PO or signed SOW), I'm inclined to tolerate a tightly scoped MFN with a cap. But not an open-ended MFN tied to “market programs” or promotional pilots.

I'll defer legal language to Laura, but from pricing: require a 12-month claim window and a max remediation equal to 10% of invoiced ARR in year 1.

- Rishi

Karthik / Rishi — reviewed Novara redline. High-level legal take and recommended language:

1) MFN: Accept only a "listed terms" MFN limited to pricing elements (list price, discount tiers) and only applicable where the customer provides a fully executed comparable contract. Exclude promotional credits, professional services discounts, and marketplace rebates. Add a cumulative liability cap equal to 6 months of revenue for Novara under the contract (reduces open-ended exposure).

2) Territory carve-out: Require Novara to provide a signed customer list and limit carve-out to those accounts for the remaining term of the contract. Add audit rights to validate the customer list. Carve-out must not apply to future accounts acquired after signature.

3) Operational mitigations: Require quarterly business reviews and alerting for similar deals in the health vertical. Add a clause that any deviation from the scoped MFN requires C-level signoff from both parties.

Attachment: redline_summary.txt — short bullets of changes and the recommended strike-through / insert language.

If Pricing and RevOps are comfortable with the cap and the reporting commitments, I'm OK escalating this for exec sign-off. If you want stricter limits, propose a shorter MFN window (6 months) or reduce the liability cap to 3 months.

Laura

--

Karthik — appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed your proposed compromise and Novara can accept the MFN scope if the carve-out is broader: we need exclusivity in our core markets for 6 months post-launch (US West / US East) because we are rolling a coordinated go-to-market with three partners. We will sign the customer list and agree to quarterly reporting, but we need the 6-month exclusivity window as a condition of the discount.

We prefer to finalize this week. Can your team confirm the exclusivity language and the liability cap?

Thanks,
Laura

Following up to pull the thread together for a final decision. Novara is asking for a 6-month exclusivity in US West / US East as part of the 30% discount. That is an additional escalation above the MFN and named-customer carve-out.

Summary of options for exec sign-off:
A) Approve scoped MFN + named-customer carve-out + 6-month regional exclusivity limited to the three named partners Novara provided. Require audit rights, quarterly reporting, and cap liability at 6 months revenue. Approve 30% discount and 24-month term.
B) Approve scoped MFN + named-customer carve-out but push back on exclusivity; offer instead a 90-day go-to-market exclusivity window tied to verified launch evidence. Approve 20% discount instead of 30%.
C) Reject exclusivity and MFN; require full price (or max 15% discount) and standard regional terms.

Please reply with APPROVE OPTION A / APPROVE OPTION B / REJECT by end of day PST. If you need a short call, I can sync — Novara expects a final answer this week and legal ops needs direction before I send the counter.

Thanks,
Karthik
